[Thinking]
**Suggesting a build for PvE/PvP**

I’m thinking of providing a concise yet helpful response for a meta PvE/PvP build. Maybe I should ask if the user wants any clarifications first. I could offer one or two strong builds for endgame, like a quality build focusing on 40/40 stats, or a dex or pyro build. I’ll also include relevant stats and gear to make it really useful. Let’s explore a couple of archetypes!
[/Thinking]

There isn’t a single “best” endgame build in Dark Souls Remastered, but there *are* a few top‑tier, very forgiving and powerful builds that work extremely well for both PvE and casual PvP.

Below are three of the strongest, easy-to-pilot endgame setups, with stat targets and gear suggestions. All assume SL ~120–130, which is the common “meta” if you care about PvP.

---

## 1. Quality Greatsword Build (Meta all‑rounder)

**Concept:** 40 STR / 40 DEX “quality” build abusing high‑scaling weapons like Claymore, Black Knight weapons, or the Greatsword of Artorias. Excellent for basically everything.

### Final Stats (around SL 120)
- VIT: 40
- ATT: 10 (or base)
- END: 40
- STR: 27 (two‑handing) or 40 (if you want 1‑hand flexibility)
- DEX: 40
- RES: base
- INT: base or 10
- FTH: base or 10

Typical spread at SL 125:
- 40 VIT / 40 END / 27 STR / 40 DEX / rest base

27 STR + 40 DEX lets you two‑hand greatswords and ultras while maintaining very high damage.

### Weapons
Pick one or two from:
- **Claymore +15** – S‑tier all‑purpose weapon (thrust R2, wide swings, versatile)
- **Balder Side Sword +15** – poke king, great moveset
- **Black Knight Greatsword** – very high damage, great stagger
- **Zweihander +15** – massive poise break, stupidly good two‑handed
- **Halberd +15** – strong 1H/2H moves, great scaling

### Armor
- Poise breakpoint to aim for: **53 poise** (tank most 1H hits) or **poise 76** if you want to tank greatswords.
- Common sets:
  - Mix **Giant’s / Black Iron / Havel’s** with lighter pieces (Hollow Soldier Waistcloth, etc.) to hit poise breakpoints while mid‑rolling.
  - Or go full **Giant’s Set** + **Havel’s Ring** if you don’t mind looking like every meta phantom.

### Rings
- **Ring of Favor and Protection** (almost mandatory: HP, STA, Equip Load)
- **Havel’s Ring** (to wear heavier armor and still mid‑roll)
  - Swap Havel’s for **Wolf Ring** if you hit your poise goal without Havel’s.

### Playstyle
- Abuse R1 spacing, roll‑R1s, and backstep attacks.
- Two‑hand against bosses for more damage/poise break.
- You have plenty of HP, stamina, and great damage, so it’s very forgiving.

---

## 2. Dex / Katana Build (High damage, very strong PvE & PvP)

**Concept:** 40 DEX with light/medium armor and extremely strong 1H weapons (kats, spears, curved swords). Great at boss melting and duels.

### Final Stats (SL 120-ish)
- VIT: 40
- ATT: 14 (for a couple of buffs/pyros if you want)
- END: 30–40
- STR: 16 (enough for most dex weapons)
- DEX: 40
- RES: base
- INT: base or 15–18 if you want magic buffs
- FTH: base or 30 if you want Sunlight Blade / DMB (then it becomes a hybrid)

Standard pure dex:
- 40 VIT / 35–40 END / 16 STR / 40 DEX / others base–14

### Weapons
- **Uchigatana +15** – bleed, versatile moveset, strong scaling
- **Balder Side Sword +15** – again, very strong choice
- **Gold Tracer** (if using DLC) – crazy bleed, fast, great for PvP
- **Spears**: Silver Knight Spear / Winged Spear +15 for safe poking
- Add **Bow** (Composite Bow +15) for ranged cheese

### Armor
- Mix to stay **< 25% equip load** if you want fast roll (best i‑frames).
  - E.g., **Black Leather / Wanderer / Shadow** sets mixed with some heavier gauntlets/leggings for a bit of defense.
- Or go **mid‑roll** (25–50%) with some poise (Wolf Ring + medium armor pieces).

### Rings
- **Ring of Favor and Protection**
- Second slot:
  - **Hornet Ring** (if you fish backstabs/ripostes)
  - **Leo Ring** (amazing with thrust weapons: BSS, spears, rapiers)
  - **Cloranthy Ring** if you like spam rolling and attacking

### Playstyle
- Dodge, punish, and bleed enemies out.
- Abuse fast roll, backstabs, and spacing.
- In PvE, you can melt bosses quickly with buffed Uchi or BSS.

---

## 3. Pyro / Quality Hybrid (S‑tier PvE, strong in co‑op)

**Concept:** Minimal stat investment for pyromancy (since pyro scales with flame upgrade, not stats) plus quality or dex for a strong weapon.

### Final Stats
- VIT: 40
- ATT: 16–19 (enough for 4–6 spell slots)
- END: 30–40
- STR: 16–27
- DEX: 30–40
- INT/FTH: can stay base; you just need a **Pyromancy Flame +15/Ascended**

Typical:
- 40 VIT / 35 END / 16 STR / 40 DEX / 16 ATT / others base

### Pyromancies
Core:
- **Great Combustion** – insane close-range DPS
- **Combustion** – backup cast
- **Great Fireball / Great Chaos Fireball** – huge damage
- **Fire Tempest / Chaos Firestorm** – boss/delete button in PvE

### Weapons
- Any good dex or quality weapon:
  - **Uchigatana / Claymore / Balder Side Sword / Halberd +15**
- Offhand: **Pyromancy Flame +15** (or Ascended to +5)

### Armor & Rings
- Same principles as above: enough poise to not get staggered out of casts, but stay under 50% load.
- Rings:
  - **Ring of Favor and Protection**
  - **Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring** (boosts pyromancy damage) or **Havel’s/Wolf** depending on your needs

### Playstyle
- Use melee as main damage; pyro to delete tough targets or punish openings.
- In PvE especially, this trivializes many bosses (Gwyn, O&S, Artorias, etc.).

---

## If you just want *one* recommendation

For a very strong, flexible endgame build that works on your first playthrough and carries into NG+:

**Recommended all‑purpose endgame build:**

- **SL ~120–125**
- VIT 40  
- ATT 10  
- END 40  
- STR 27  
- DEX 40  
- Others base

Gear:
- **Claymore +15** (or Zweihander +15 if you like ultras)
- **Giant’s/Black Iron/Havel mix** to hit ~53 poise with mid‑roll
- **Ring of Favor and Protection + Havel’s Ring**

This will comfortably clear the entire game and is very effective in co‑op and casual PvP.

---

If you tell me:
- Your current soul level
- Your current stats
- Which weapons you like (fast/dex, big/slow, spells, etc.)

I can give you a tailored “best” endgame build and exact leveling path from where you are now.
